Bug_Title: Nm: Method doesn’t override method in superclass due to wrong package for parameter (NM_WRONG_PACKAGE)
Bug_Explanation: The method f(beta.Foo x) in class B does not override the method f(alpha.Foo x) in class A because the parameter types are from different packages (alpha.Foo vs beta.Foo).
Trigger_Explanation: The test calls the showBug method of BugDemonstrator, which internally calls the method f of class B with a beta.Foo object. Due to the NM_WRONG_PACKAGE bug, the method f of class B does not override the method f of class A, resulting in B's method being called instead of A's method.
